excerpt: Where ‘䊐’ formalizes metaphysical necessity, consider, then, the following thesis: necessity: if [p] is (fully) grounded in D, then 䊐(∧D → p).
overview: This formal statement fixes the paper’s target thesis. It identifies the relevant modal consequence of full grounding: the propositions corresponding to a full ground must metaphysically necessitate the proposition corresponding to what is grounded. The formula also limits the claim to full grounds rather than partial explanatory factors.
title: Necessity Thesis Formula
